ranks: Aetherdrift (DFT, 2025-02-14), Aetherdrift Commander (DRC, 2025-02-14) and Foundations (FDN, 2024-11-15): the rest of the sets

blocked.name: Webstrike Elite
blocked.why: Cycling {X}{G}{G} and 'when you cycle this card, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment with mana value X': CardDefinition.cycling's cost takes no X (cyclingAbilityOf/cycleCard pay a fixed cost) and the this-cycled trigger has no X to read.

blocked.name: Mimeoplasm, Revered One
blocked.why: 'As Mimeoplasm enters, exile up to X creature cards from your graveyard' with three +1/+1 counters per card exiled has no as-enters exile choice, and '{2}: becomes a copy of target creature card exiled with it' needs a target spec over cards exiled with the source (no exile TargetSpec exists).

blocked.name: Canyon Vaulter
blocked.why: 'Whenever this creature saddles a Mount or crews a Vehicle during your main phase, that Mount or Vehicle gains flying' needs a trigger on a creature crewing/saddling (with the crewed permanent as the trigger object); no such trigger event exists.

blocked.name: Adrenaline Jockey
blocked.why: 'Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, put a +1/+1 counter' — the activates-ability trigger narrows by ninjutsu/loyalty/source only, not exhaust (its first ability, the off-turn cast trigger, is expressible with cast-spell offTurn).

blocked.name: The Last Ride
blocked.why: 'The Last Ride gets -X/-X, where X is your life total' — grantPtPerCount has no life-total count (filters, graveyard, exile, counters, speed, commander casts/mana value only).

blocked.name: Flood the Engine
blocked.why: 'Enchanted permanent loses all abilities' is a static on the Aura; ability loss exists only as an effect modifier (lose-abilities with a duration), which wouldn't follow the Aura's attachment or apply from the moment it's attached.

blocked.name: Trade the Helm
blocked.why: Exchange control of two targets (one yours, one an opponent's) has no effect in the vocabulary; only gain-control exists, and the exchange must not happen if either target is illegal (ruling).

blocked.name: Elvish Refueler
blocked.why: "During your turn, as long as you haven't activated an exhaust ability this turn, you may activate exhaust abilities as though they haven't been activated" has no static: the exhaust once-only check (exhaustedAbilities) can't be waived, and nothing tracks whether you activated an exhaust ability this turn.

blocked.name: Sita Varma, Masked Racer
blocked.why: "Base power and toughness of each other creature you control become equal to Sita Varma's power" needs animate-all with an exceptSource clause; a notName filter would wrongly spare a nonlegendary copy named Sita Varma.

blocked.name: Reckless Velocitaur
blocked.why: No trigger fires when this creature crews a Vehicle or saddles a Mount (with a reference to that Vehicle/Mount and a during-your-main-phase gate); activates-ability can't see which creatures paid a crew/saddle cost.

blocked.name: Skyseer's Chariot
blocked.why: "As this Vehicle enters, choose a nonland card name" has no decision, and no ability-cost increase keys off a chosen name.

blocked.name: Silken Strength
blocked.why: "When this Aura enters, untap enchanted permanent" — no EffectTargetRef or untap clause names the permanent the Aura is attached to (only phase-out has attachedToSource).

blocked.name: Rangers' Refueler
blocked.why: "Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, draw a card" needs the activates-ability trigger narrowed to exhaust abilities (it has ninjutsu and loyalty narrowings only); unnarrowed it would draw for crew and every other ability.

blocked.name: Wickerfolk Indomitable
blocked.why: The card's own cast-from-graveyard permission with additional costs (pay 2 life and sacrifice an artifact or creature): castFromGraveyardIf takes no extra costs, and castFromGraveyard (which has payLife/sacrifice) is a battlefield permanent's grant.

blocked.name: Intimidation Tactics
blocked.why: "You choose an artifact or creature card from it. Exile that card": discard-chosen only discards the chosen card; there is no exile destination for a card chosen from a revealed hand.

blocked.name: Trip Up
blocked.why: "Its owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library": put-on-library takes a fixed position, with no choice for the permanent's owner.

blocked.name: Afterburner Expert
blocked.why: "Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, return this card from your graveyard": activates-ability can't be narrowed to exhaust abilities (only ninjutsu/loyalty), and its matcher requires the trigger's own card to be on the battlefield, so a fromGraveyard version would never fire.

blocked.name: Boom Scholar
blocked.why: "Exhaust abilities of other permanents you control cost {2} less": abilityCostModification filters the source permanent but can't be narrowed to exhaust abilities (only ninjutsu/unlock).

blocked.name: Rangers' Aetherhive
blocked.why: "Whenever you activate an exhaust ability, create a Thopter": activates-ability has no exhaust narrowing; unnarrowed it would fire on every activated ability.

blocked.name: Spikeshell Harrier
blocked.why: "If that opponent's speed is greater than each other player's speed, reduce that opponent's speed by 1 ... not below 1": there is no effect lowering another player's speed and no condition comparing one player's speed against every other player's.

blocked.name: Sabotage Strategist
blocked.why: "Whenever one or more creatures attack you, those creatures get -1/-0": attack-with only counts its batch (and its attackingYou includes planeswalkers); a per-attacker `attacks` trigger would fire once per creature instead of once per batch.

blocked.name: Ancient Vendetta
blocked.why: "Choose a card name. Search target opponent's graveyard, hand, and library for up to four cards with that name and exile them": no choose-a-card-name decision, and search-library can't search a hand and graveyard together with the library.

blocked.name: Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker
blocked.why: "You may pay eight {E} rather than pay the mana cost for permanent spells you cast": alternativeCostForSpells takes only a mana cost, not an energy payment.

blocked.name: Rampaging Aetherhood
blocked.why: "Then you may pay one or more {E}. If you do, put that many +1/+1 counters": no variable energy payment whose amount the player chooses and the effect reads.

blocked.name: Territorial Aetherkite
blocked.why: "Then you may pay one or more {E}. When you do, this creature deals that much damage to each other creature": a may's costEnergy is a fixed amount, with no way for the player to choose how much energy to pay and no X carrying the amount paid into the reflexive trigger.

blocked.name: Pia Nalaar, Chief Mechanic
blocked.why: "You may pay one or more {E}. If you do, create an X/X ... Nalaar Aetherjet ... where X is the amount of {E} paid this way": no player-chosen energy payment with X = amount paid (the X/X token itself is expressible with create-token's basePt; the first trigger is Thopter Spy Network's shape).

blocked.name: Curator of Destinies
blocked.why: "Separate them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. An opponent chooses one of those piles": no pile-separation decision or opponent pile choice in the vocabulary.

blocked.name: Fiery Annihilation
blocked.why: "If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead" on a target isn't built, nor a target filter for "up to one target Equipment attached to that creature" (attached to the object in another slot).

blocked.name: Kellan, Planar Trailblazer
blocked.why: The first ability's "it becomes a Human Faerie Detective" overwrites its creature types without touching P/T, but the only one-shot that sets subtypes (animate's setSubtypes) always sets base P/T too, which would wrongly overwrite earlier P/T-setting effects (the first ruling); the second ability (animate 3/2 + double strike, permanent) is expressible.

blocked.name: Soul-Shackled Zombie
blocked.why: "Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard": an any-number card-in-graveyard group can't require both targets to share one graveyard.

blocked.name: Fishing Pole
blocked.why: The granted "{1}, {T}, Tap Fishing Pole: Put a bait counter on Fishing Pole" names the granting Equipment in both its cost (tapping the granter, not the creature) and its effect, and a granted ability's cost and effect can only reach the permanent it's on.

blocked.name: Uncharted Voyage
blocked.why: "Target creature's owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library": put-on-library takes a fixed position, and each-player-may's controllerOfTarget asks the controller, not the owner (wrong for a stolen creature).

blocked.name: Starlight Snare
blocked.why: "Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step": the untap step reads doesntUntap only from a permanent's own statics (Game.hasOwnStatic), so an Aura can't give it to the enchanted creature (the enters tap itself would be fine).
